paper.heading: Payment details
paper.note: Real values appear in the app before you pay.

points.title: Every detail before you pay
points.body: Before you confirm, see the amount in pounds and in your currency, with the fee shown on its own.

points.title: The rate, with its timestamp
points.body: See the rate and when it was updated, so you know exactly what you’re paying.

points.title: Your money back in full if it doesn’t arrive
points.body: If something goes wrong after you pay, you get it all back automatically. No need to ask.
